sentences.text: William Bradley Pitt -LRB- born December 18 , 1963 -RRB- is an American actor and producer .

He has received multiple awards and nominations including an Academy Award as producer under his own company Plan B Entertainment .	multiple awards and nominations	List of awards and nominations received by Brad Pitt	Academy Award	Academy Award	Plan B Entertainment	Plan B Entertainment
Pitt first gained recognition as a cowboy hitchhiker in the road movie Thelma & Louise -LRB- 1991 -RRB- .	gained recognition	Brad Pitt filmography	Thelma & Louise	Thelma & Louise

His first leading roles in big-budget productions came with the dramas A River Runs Through It -LRB- 1992 -RRB- and Legends of the Fall -LRB- 1994 -RRB- , and Interview with the Vampire -LRB- 1994 -RRB- .	A River Runs Through It	A River Runs Through It (film)	Legends of the Fall	Legends of the Fall	Interview with the Vampire	Interview with the Vampire (film)

He gave critically acclaimed performances in the crime thriller Seven and the science fiction film 12 Monkeys -LRB- both 1995 -RRB- , the latter earning him a Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actor and an Academy Award nomination . As a public figure , Pitt has been cited as one of the most influential and powerful people in the American entertainment industry , as well as the world 's most attractive man , by various media outlets .	most attractive man	Sex symbol
His personal life is also the subject of wide publicity .

Divorced from actress Jennifer Aniston , to whom he was married for five years , he has been married to actress Angelina Jolie since 2014 .	Jennifer Aniston	Jennifer Aniston	Angelina Jolie	Angelina Jolie
They have six children together , three of whom were adopted internationally .
In September 2016 , Jolie filed for divorce from Pitt .
